content.title: BRIGHT GAME
about: BRIGHT GAME is a retro-inspired arcade shooter influenced by Geometry Wars and classic bullet-hell games.
The project was designed to support multiple modes (Arcade, Roguelike, Dodge/Survival, and Challenges). The public build currently includes only the Arcade mode.
This was my first fully solo 2D project, from gameplay and feel to building and shipping a Windows release.
features: Fast-paced arcade loop built around dodging dense projectile patterns
Score-chasing gameplay with short, replayable runs
Neon/retro visual direction and responsive movement
Extensible design for additional modes (Roguelike, Dodge, Challenges)
learnings: Building a complete game loop as a solo developer
Tuning difficulty curves and readability in bullet-hell gameplay
Packaging and distributing builds for players
